errors.text: The hypothesis assigns disappearance of small particles primarily to Ostwald ripening and predicts growth of surviving particles, whereas the target mechanism emphasizes Au/Cu surface segregation followed by melting and evaporation, including an overall particle-size reduction.
It predicts evolution toward faceted structures, opposite to the observed elliptical-to-spherical reshaping.

The falsification rule treats retention or development of spherical shape as evidence for sluggish kinetics, even though spherical reshaping is coupled to enhanced diffusion and segregation in the target result.
